notes.title: Ardent Wilds Joins Tiny Teams 2025!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45217154/5b908e7b6abeff17d3133235151757ae9ee858c9.png"][/img][/p][p]Greetings, gamers.[/p][p]We have some exciting news! [b]Ardent Wilds[/b] has been selected to take part in [b]Tiny Teams 2025[/b], the annual showcase by Yogscast that highlights the most exciting indie games created by small teams of fewer than five developers.[/p][p]From [b]August 7th to August 14th[/b], content creators will be playtesting and streaming the game for the very first time. You’ll be able to watch them discover, strategize, and survive in real time, and maybe even pick up a few tips before embarking on your own journey.[/p][p]In addition, [b]playtest signups will open on August 7th[/b], right before the start of the event. Your feedback is crucial during this early stage of development, and we can’t wait to hear your thoughts to help make the game the best it can be.[/p][p]We couldn’t be more excited to share this experience with you and the Tiny Teams community. [/p][p]Stay tuned for more [b]details on the upcoming playtest[/b] and our [b]roadmap[/b], the Midrealms await[b]![/b][/p]
